title: Coherent carrier of an open section
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], $E$ a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $U$ an open subset, and $s\in E(U)$. There are a coherent quasi-coherent module $H$, a monomorphism $h:H\to E$, and $t\in H(U)$ with $h_U(t)=s$.

source.place: First paragraph of Tag 01YB; Properties Tag 01PF and Cohomology of Schemes Tag 01XZ.

proof.text: Form the rank-one free module on the slice site Over U and map its basis section to the restrictions of s. Take the abelian image. Transport through overEquiv U, apply quasi-coherent cokernel and kernel closure on U.toScheme, and transport back to show the image is quasi-coherent. Push the single free generator along the epimorphic image factorization to obtain finite local generators of the image. The factorThruImage map applied to the free basis gives a section of the image mapping exactly to s.

Every open of a Noetherian scheme is compact, and the scheme is compact and quasi-separated. Apply the finite-type submodule extension theorem to the image inclusion, obtaining H, a monomorphism h to E, and an isomorphism e from H.over U to the image commuting with inclusions. Apply the locally Noetherian finite-type/coherence equivalence to H.

Evaluate the inverse of e at the terminal object of Over U on the image section to define the witness t. Evaluate the commuting inclusion equation and the inverse-hom identity to conclude h_U(t)=s. No sectionwise surjectivity of the image factorization is assumed. The construction works for empty U and zero s as well.
